```{=html}
<svg class="story-scattering-animation" viewBox="0 0 920 520" role="img" aria-label="Repulsion and attraction as two signs of one scattering mechanism">
  <defs>
    <filter id="story-particle-glow" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="920" height="520" rx="24" fill="#050505"/>
  <line x1="460" y1="56" x2="460" y2="464" class="center-line"/>

  <g transform="translate(0 10)">
    <text x="52" y="48" class="scattering-panel-title">Repulsion</text>
    <text x="52" y="78" class="scattering-panel-subtitle">like charges bend away</text>
    <circle cx="230" cy="260" r="118" class="field-ring field-pulse"/>
    <circle cx="230" cy="260" r="74" class="field-ring field-pulse"/>
    <path d="M 44 212 C 140 212, 210 198, 338 102" class="trajectory"/>
    <path d="M 416 308 C 320 308, 250 322, 122 418" class="trajectory"/>

    <g class="charge-orbit" filter="url(#story-particle-glow)">
      <circle r="18" class="charge-positive"/>
      <text y="1">+</text>
      <animateMotion dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="0" path="M 44 212 C 140 212, 210 198, 338 102"/>
    </g>

    <g class="charge-orbit" filter="url(#story-particle-glow)">
      <circle r="18" class="charge-positive"/>
      <text y="1">+</text>
      <animateMotion dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="0" path="M 416 308 C 320 308, 250 322, 122 418"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <g transform="translate(0 10)">
    <text x="512" y="48" class="scattering-panel-title">Attraction</text>
    <text x="512" y="78" class="scattering-panel-subtitle">opposite charges bend toward each other</text>
    <circle cx="690" cy="260" r="118" class="field-ring field-pulse"/>
    <circle cx="690" cy="260" r="74" class="field-ring field-pulse"/>
    <path d="M 520 217 C 650 218, 710 235, 844 340" class="trajectory"/>
    <path d="M 858 303 C 728 302, 670 285, 536 180" class="trajectory"/>

    <g class="charge-orbit" filter="url(#story-particle-glow)">
      <circle r="18" class="charge-positive"/>
      <text y="1">+</text>
      <animateMotion dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="0" path="M 520 217 C 650 218, 710 235, 844 340"/>
    </g>

    <g class="charge-orbit" filter="url(#story-particle-glow)">
      <circle r="18" class="charge-negative"/>
      <text y="1">-</text>
      <animateMotion dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="0" path="M 858 303 C 728 302, 670 285, 536 180"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
```
